description: Turn a free-text listening mood into search terms (genres, keywords, terms to avoid) for search. Uses the host model via MCP sampling when the host advertises the sampling capability; otherwise returns a built-in static map. Calls no Spotify endpoint and changes nothing. A model reply that cannot be parsed returns isError after one retry — it is never replaced by a guess.

max_tokens.description: Token ceiling for the sampling call. Default: 512. Ignored on the static-map path

mood.description: The mood or vibe to expand, in free text (e.g. "rainy afternoon", "late night coding")

response_format.description: 'concise' = human prose, 'detailed' = more fields in prose, 'json' = raw API object

name: expand_mood_to_queries
